changeSet.author: beefcare
changeSet.sql: UPDATE farm_membership SET joined_at = (SELECT MIN(a.logged_at) FROM audit_log a WHERE a.action = 'MEMBER_ACCEPT' AND a.target_type = 'FarmMembership' AND a.target_id = farm_membership.id) WHERE joined_at IS NULL

UPDATE farm_membership SET joined_at = (SELECT MIN(a.logged_at) FROM audit_log a WHERE a.action = 'FARM_REGISTER' AND a.target_type = 'Farm' AND a.target_id = farm_membership.farm_id) WHERE joined_at IS NULL AND UPPER(role) = 'OWNER'

UPDATE farm_membership SET joined_at = (SELECT MIN(i.accepted_at) FROM farm_invitation i JOIN app_user u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(i.invited_email) WHERE i.farm_id = farm_membership.farm_id AND u.id = farm_membership.user_id AND UPPER(i.status) = 'ACCEPTED') WHERE joined_at IS NULL
UPDATE farm_membership SET joined_at = CAST(effective_date AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE joined_at IS NULL
